name: e2_phase_a
description: Fresh Phase-A models, one per held-out phonebook: train on book A, evaluate on book B, default model config and the trainer's default learning rate.

decision_rules.gate: Each Phase-A checkpoint must recall all ten entries of its own book A exactly. If one does not after 100 updates, that phonebook is retrained from scratch with 200 and then 400 updates (a new spec each time) and every attempt is kept as evidence.
